## Minitest

Ships with Ruby. `assert_equal`, `assert_raises`, and parallel runs. Simple and fast for libraries.

## RSpec

Expressive DSL (`describe` / `it` / `expect`). Popular in apps; keep examples focused and avoid over-mocking.

## What to test

Prefer behavior at public boundaries. Table-driven examples and factories beat one giant fixture file.

blocks.code:
require "minitest/autorun"

class SumTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_sum
    assert_equal 6, [1, 2, 3].sum
  end
end
